name: prof-f04-john-lewis — extracted from f04-john-lewis
palette: Naturalistic seasonal shifts: warm forest greens and browns under golden light, evolving into cool winter whites and soft blues with restrained, festive reds and greens as accents.
light_logic: Consistent, story-driven daylight that moves from soft, hopeful warmth to overcast, diffuse cold, then to a dim, cave interior contrasted against bright snow outside.
lens: Gently cinematic with moderate focal lengths: wide establishing vistas, then medium and close shots with shallow depth of field to read subtle emotion on simple, animated faces.
texture: Soft, tactile rendering of fur, snow, and foliage with slightly stylized realism; edges and details are gentle rather than sharp, supporting a tender, storybook feel.
world: A stylized but believable woodland and mountain world where animals behave with humanlike emotional intelligence yet remain non-verbal, and seasonal rituals feel timeless and familiar.
forbidden: Harsh, high-contrast lighting or neon, synthetic color schemes that break the naturalistic mood
Fast, jittery cutting or aggressive camera moves that disrupt the calm, contemplative pacing
Complex dialogue or on-the-nose exposition that explains the relationship instead of showing it
Overly cartoony slapstick or exaggerated expressions that undercut the quiet emotional tone
Intrusive modern objects or urban settings that break the self-contained forest world
